title: rDPS Meter
changeNote: 0.1.23 - the Necrobinder's Osty now counts on the Blocked tab. Damage Osty takes in your place is booked under a row named Osty, because Summon is the Necrobinder's Defend and a fight spent summoning rather than blocking should not read as having stopped nothing. Two limits, both deliberate. Only what Osty actually had to give counts: a hit bigger than Osty books what it absorbed, and the excess that carries on through to you does not, the same way overkill has never counted as damage dealt. And only damage diverted off you counts - an enemy that attacks Osty directly was never going to hit you, so crediting it would pad the number. Also checked against game v0.110.1, which needed no changes. Still works on game v0.107.1 and later.
